faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Menlo Park?
faq.answer: Menlo Park homeowners typically invest $10,000 to $25,000 for a full window replacement project. This prestigious Peninsula community — home to Sand Hill Road venture capital and Stanford-adjacent neighborhoods — features large single-family homes where premium window specifications are routine. Projects covering 15–25 windows with Andersen or Marvin are common. Single window installation starts at approximately $750.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Menlo Park?
faq.answer: Yes. Menlo Park requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team handles all permit applications with the City of Menlo Park's Community Development Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Menlo Park?
faq.answer: Menlo Park's high-value Peninsula market demands top-tier specifications. We most frequently install Marvin Elevate for estate properties in Sharon Heights and Allied Arts Ranch, Andersen 400-Series wood-clad for Craftsman and Colonial homes, and Western Window Systems for contemporary homes with indoor-outdoor living requirements.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Menlo Park neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve all Menlo Park neighborhoods including Allied Arts Ranch, Sharon Heights, West Menlo Park, Central Menlo Park, Belle Haven, and Linfield Oaks. Zip codes: 94025, 94027.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Menlo Park?
faq.answer: Most Menlo Park projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
